scenarios.name: Toggle Modify from Show Panels while its additional commands are open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the Modify additional command area is open
the user opens Show Panels from the active tab context menu
Modify is checked in the panel list
the Modify panel and its additional command area are hidden
the user reopens Show Panels from the active tab context menu
the main Modify panel is visible
the additional command area remains closed
